cases.expected: instance of ZeroCostModel returned (same object as provided to constructor)
cases.description: Verify that getHoldingCostModel() returns the CostModel that was injected via the BarSeriesManager constructor when a non‑null model (ZeroCostModel) is supplied.
Verify that getHoldingCostModel() returns null when the BarSeriesManager is constructed with a null holdingCostModel (allowed by the class).

cases.expected: instance of CustomCostModel returned (same object as provided to constructor)
cases.description: Verify that getHoldingCostModel() returns the exact CostModel instance when a user‑defined implementation (anonymous class) is injected via the constructor.

cases.expected: instance of mocked CostModel returned (same object as provided to constructor)
cases.description: Verify that getHoldingCostModel() returns the mocked CostModel (e.g., created with Mockito) that was supplied to the constructor, confirming that no proxy or copy is created.

cases.expected: original CostModel instance still returned after external reference reassignment
cases.description: Confirm that the manager keeps a reference to the CostModel given at construction: after reassigning the variable that originally held the CostModel to a different object, getHoldingCostModel() still returns the original instance.
